name: send_message
description: Send text to one or more correspondents by ID. Each call submits one message and returns a submission reference; submission does not confirm recipient delivery.

name: fork_session
description: Transfer this activation's whole work and retained context to a child, returning its stable session_id. The caller returns to its queue; unadmitted events and existing callbacks keep their destinations. Results reach the caller and core automatically. At most one fork per round.

task.description: Task and continuation instructions for the activation's whole work.

name: send_session_message
description: Durably queue an observation for an existing session, recording your session as its source. A dormant recipient wakes; a running recipient receives it before a later decision.

session_id.description: Recipient session ID from current state, a fork, or retained history.

name: wakeup
description: Schedule one observation for this session and return its callback_id. The arrangement survives restart. Past times are due immediately; inference can occur later. Return control when ready to sleep.

at_unix_ms.description: Unix time in milliseconds. Current runtime time is supplied in state.

text.description: What to reconsider when this observation arrives.
